flowRoot.flowPara: Script Start!
Reminder: Return to this page at the start of each turn!.
Phase I: Start of Turn
Read the following at the start of turn 3; read only the bolded parts on turns 6, 9, etc.:

The necrotic mist surrounding Golgothon thickens, filling your lungs with a sickly-sweet scent of death. With each breath, you feel your limbs grow weaker; your will to fight fades. The mist is thinner further from the creature - escape the epicenter before Death's Caress lulls you to a final rest.
Read the following at the start of the encounter:

Before you stands a creature that can only be described as a "walking graveyard." Twenty feet of mossy rock and upturned earth, its body is adorned with shattered gravestones, cemetary lanterns and half-exumed corpses. An aura of necrotic mist lingers around the creature. As it lurches toward you, the grass at your feet withers and dies and the whispers of lost souls fill your ears. It's hollow eyes betray no emotion, but it's motives are undeniable: it exists only to extinguish life.
Phase II: Player Phase
There are no encounter actions during this phase. Once the players have completed their actions, proceed to Phase III: Encounter Phase.
RAID BOSS TIP
• If players don't seem to be reacting to the warning for Death's Caress, you may wish to remind them and emphasize how deadly the attack is. If they still don't react, well, hey, you tried!

flowRoot.flowPara: Each foe in the burst loses 28 health.
This amount is reduced by 4 for each square between Golgothon and the target.
This effect does not require line of sight.

flowRoot.flowPara: Unquenched
Gain 1 Unquenched stack. Each stack scales the encounter up by 1 step.
Then, replace each
Restless Dead token with
a Welcoming Dead minion. Lose 4 health for each token replaced.
Phase III: Encounter
Read the following when this skill is used (read only the bolded part on subsequent uses):

flowRoot.flowPara: Golgothon lets loose a low, tuneful moaning sound - a beautiful and horrible lullaby. Against your will, you find yourself longing for the embrace of the death, and your legs carry you closer to the monster.
Strike each foe in the
burst for 5(±1) damage.
Starting with the foe closest to him, each foe is forced 5 squares toward Golgothon.
This effect does not require line of sight.
>> If a unit can’t get closer to Golgothon because of a wall, the forced movement ends.
>> Units can be pulled through friendly units. If a unit ends the force in an occupied square, it is moved to the nearest unoccupied square.
>> Units take damage even if they aren't forced.
>> Numbers that scale with Unquenched stacks are indicated by a (±n) after the base value.
Read the following if this skill damages one or more players.
The necrotic mist fills your lungs, sapping your lifeforce.
Read the following when this skill is used.
Golgothon roars, his hunger for more life energy fueling his fury. Animating energy flows out from the creature, weakening it - but the zombies you had defeated rise again with renewed fervor.
NOTE: Count outward from Golgothon to the affected unit to determine distance. Units in melee range with Golgothon are technically 1 square away.
